bio: Adorned with the work of some of the greatest mosaicists, engravers and sculptors of the Art deco period, the lavish interior of Prunier is well worth a trip in its own right. The menu gives pride of place to seafood and Prunier’s legendary caviar, of course. We recommend house signature dishes, such as the Christian Dior Egg (poached and sprinkled with caviar) or fish to be shared....
